video_title: Unrivaled's Big Investment, Liberty Playoff Push & Myles' Wild Bucks Camp

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Unrivaled's 650 million valuation and new high-profile investors
quotes.excerpt: Y'all's new valuation is now at 650 million, came a long way from where you started.
quotes.quote: Congratulations on the success of Unrivaled. Y'all's new valuation is now at 650 million, came a long way from where you started. Got some new investors including Carmelo Anthony, your old coach Gino Auriemma, Ashton Kutcher, Alexis Ohanian, Trae Young. I guess the real question is, what took Gino so long?

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on Gino Auriemma's involvement with Unrivaled
quotes.excerpt: Maybe he wanted to see it come to fruition or he was waiting for his next big contract.
quotes.quote: I'm not sure what took him so long. Maybe he wanted to see it come to fruition or he was waiting for his next big contract extension. He had to get a little bit more money to put some more into something. But better late than never, Coach, so we're happy to have you.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Unrivaled's 650 million valuation shows the league's potential
quotes.excerpt: A valuation of 650 million is competing with the top WNBA teams.
quotes.quote: The new valuation shows the potential that we have, the direction that we're heading. A valuation of 650 million is competing with the top WNBA teams. And these teams have been around for 30 years. So just the potential that we have and really exciting to have people backing us constantly.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Unrivaled's upcoming tour stops include a returning city
quotes.excerpt: One of the cities is going to repeat from last year.

text_blocks.speaker: Breanna Stewart
text_blocks.text: The breaking news that I can give is that one of the cities is going to repeat from last year. And the three others are new.

text_blocks.speaker: Myles Turner
text_blocks.text: We like some fresh markets, get some more fans following the game. But I would assume you must have had success in this repeat city last year, so we'll all be looking forward to seeing what that is.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: New York Liberty roster outlook for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: I don't think that we're going to have a complete redraft like we did last year.
quotes.quote: I don't think that we're going to have a complete redraft like we did last year, because the goal to that was to be able to keep people on the same team. So I'm hoping all my Unrivaled group will be back together for those that are returning. It's four of us returning, but stay tuned.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: New York Liberty's focus on playing their best basketball
quotes.excerpt: It's not really about who we're going to match up with, but more so us playing our best.
quotes.quote: Obviously we want to get the highest seed possible. It's not really about who we're going to match up with, but more so us playing our best. We just had a tough one last night against the Valkyries. They're a really good team, they play really well together.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Impact of Breanna Stewart's return on the team
quotes.excerpt: To have a starter back in our lineup, to have someone that's comfortable with the players around.
quotes.quote: Leo Fiebich has been huge. You don't want to put an incredible amount of pressure on one player coming back, but to have a starter back in our lineup, to have someone that's comfortable with the players around and 6'4 frame, defensively she helps me a lot. It's exciting to know that we're as full as we're going to get with our roster.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on the Milwaukee Bucks' new roster and coaching staff
quotes.excerpt: This is an entirely new group this year. We have a new coaching staff.
quotes.quote: This is an entirely new group this year. We have a new coaching staff, we have a new player development staff, we have a bunch of new players. I had to miss everybody in Summer League. I was in Europe this year and me and Asia Durr got engaged, so priorities are priorities.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner's experience hosting an armadillo race
quotes.excerpt: One of my favorite parts was I hosted an armadillo race.
quotes.quote: One of my favorite parts was I hosted an armadillo race. Texas tradition to say that. I personally have never done it before, but a lot of people actually do it. I hired this outside company and they set up a whole big ass box basically, starting and finish line.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on the armadillo race results
quotes.excerpt: Me and AJ Green were racing against each other and my armadillo won.
quotes.quote: We did a couple races. It was me and AJ Green racing against each other and my armadillo won, of course. And then Kyle Kuzma and our rookie Nate Ament, they did a race. Kuz took off from the start line and he stopped right at the finish line. He didn't cross the finish line. He started turning around and Kuz thought he won. So Nate, he kept on going, kept on patting his on the butt or whatever and it crossed the finish line.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on the benefits of player-led camps
quotes.excerpt: This is a player-led camp. When you get into training camp, it's all coaches.
quotes.quote: This is a player-led camp. When you get into training camp, it's all coaches, it's all player development. You're on their schedule. When you do a player-led camp, you literally get the feedback directly of the players of what we want to do. I like these player conversations because now we're working on things we want to work on.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on her daughter starting kindergarten
quotes.excerpt: Ruby is starting kindergarten after Labor Day, which is super late this year actually.
quotes.quote: Ruby is starting kindergarten after Labor Day, which is super late this year actually. The list for school supplies is kind of insane. Buying so many things, but also I feel like they're trying to trick me. I'm literally searching all over for 16-count colored pencils. There's no 16-count colored pencils. It's 12 and it's 24.
